name: Attempt Sync
description: Sync hdlolhfff's Attempt Playback ghosts in both directions

upload-my-attempts.name: Upload My Attempts
upload-my-attempts.description: Enable to upload this device's attempts to hdlolhfff/gd-attempts as well as download everyone else's. Changed files show a size/attempt comparison and ask once before syncing. Builds with a built-in writer token enable this automatically on first launch; turn it off to make this device read-only. Your own token needs repository Write access.

github-token.name: GitHub Token
github-token.description: Your own GitHub token for hdlolhfff/gd-attempts. Uploading needs Contents read/write plus collaborator Write access on the repository. Viewers need no token when the repository is public; private viewing needs their own authorized read-only token. A built-in token from a shared build is installed once and never overwrites this value. Stored locally in plain text; do not share it.

auto-sync.name: Sync at Main Menu
auto-sync.description: Compare files when the main menu opens. With Upload My Attempts on, one confirmation covers all changed files before syncing; with it off, the device only downloads.
